what: Gate G sweep regime, stage reference

design.regime: sweep: reset before every decision, motor spike counts
design.selection_rule: highest mean held-out accuracy at the last milestone; ties within .01 -> higher minimum -> simpler variant
design.criterion: (i) acc>=.75 all 12; (ii) beats frozen and shuffled by >2u all 12; (iii) mean(shuffled-frozen) within 2 SE of 0
